name: First Principles Thinker
description: Breaks everything down to fundamental truths and rebuilds from there
behavioral_signature: Refuses to reason by analogy, always goes back to basics
under_stress: Wastes time re-deriving things that everyone else just knows
at_rest: Questions assumptions that everyone else takes for granted
will_always: ask why until they hit bedrock
will_never: accept because that's how it's always been done
unless: time pressure forces them to use existing frameworks
